title: Television
scope: Independent English saved-pixel display review only; the outstanding revision is mobile local-scroll reachability evidence, not source fidelity or science.

observations.observation: Both saved views visibly read Television and Printed page 152. Neither displays a fabricated chapter, section, null, or undefined breadcrumb. The bound lesson and its source.data both have chapter:null and section:null, with start_printed:152.

observations.criterion: Complete English narrative and inline formulas
observations.observation: The whole-page pixels show all 22 narrative paragraphs, from image transmission through the concluding satellite-relay paragraph, with one intervening figure and caption. There are no concept-boundary headings or exercises. Text wraps within the prose column, including the bold camera-tube, image-signal, and picture-tube terms. The two inline mathematical R glyphs are legible and aligned with surrounding prose, without literal dollar delimiters, missing glyph boxes, overlap, or clipped lines. The visible 540-meter and 120-kilometer historical example is readable. This checks presentation, not scientific correctness.

Figure 125 is visible, centered below the schematic, and separated from the following receiver paragraph in both whole-page images. It matches the bound caption object, whose source_refs are p0163#2 and whose source_text is the original figure-number caption. Its figure page is 153; the lesson breadcrumb correctly remains the starting printed page 152. No new descriptive caption or source-image review was introduced.

observations.criterion: Entire schematic and English labels at actual media width 640
observations.observation: The full desktop figure image shows the lens, tube outline, gun, internal beam lines, mosaic screen, external wiring, resistor, battery signs, ground mark, and both rightward output arrows without canvas-edge clipping or label collision. Lens, Electron gun, Mosaic screen, R, Amplifier, minus, and plus are all clear. The figure capture is 686 pixels wide because it includes its surrounding figure box; the report measures the actual media at 640 pixels, not 686. Both view reports measure labels at approximately 21.333 pixels with actual Arial glyph evidence, above the 16-pixel contract. The mobile left-hand slice independently shows Lens, Electron gun, and both battery signs at the same readable scale. Full-diagram readability at 640 is established by the desktop pixels; mobile reachability of its right-hand portion is a separate outstanding criterion.

observations.criterion: Mobile page-wide overflow and separation from local media scrolling
observations.observation: The 390-pixel-wide whole-page image retains readable prose with 16-pixel side margins through the final paragraph; no text extends past the page edges. The report records document scrollWidth/pageWidth 390 and a figure container spanning x=16 to x=374, width 358, while its media remains 640 pixels wide. The diagram's right edge is intentionally outside the local viewport, not evidence of page-wide overflow or an intrinsically clipped source figure. The 358-pixel mobile figure capture shows only the left-hand slice and does not itself prove horizontal reachability.

observations.criterion: Mobile local-scroll end and full-diagram reachability
observations.observation: The mobile saved pixels stop before Mosaic screen, R, Amplifier, the ground symbol, and the output arrows. This is compatible with intentional local scrolling and is not labeled a clipping defect. However, the supplied report contains no local clientWidth/scrollWidth/scrollLeft measurements, successful end-scroll result, or rightmost-content visibility assertion. The read-only executed-helper snapshot captures the figure container and checks page geometry and fonts, but does not exercise horizontal local scrolling. Width 640 and errors:[] do not prove that the hidden portion is reachable.

findings.summary: Mobile local-scroll end reachability is unverified in the supplied evidence.
findings.requiredRevision: Supply affected-only hash-bound offline evidence that the 358-pixel mobile media container can scroll to the end of its 640-pixel diagram and expose the rightmost labels and output arrows. Record the container dimensions, attempted and achieved scroll position, and end visibility assertion. Reuse the already reviewed full-diagram readability and prior source/science/figure approvals; no new source images or science evaluation is required.

reuse.scopeNote: Existing approval reuse is a premise supplied by the requester, not a fresh source-fidelity or science certification by this pixel reviewer.

limitations: Independent visual inspection of exactly six existing saved images from an isolated headless offline capture; no headed or live browser verification.
No production, database, publication, or full-course acceptance claim.
No full accessibility approval: the report discloses the retained Chinese machine aria-label for Figure 125, and no assistive-technology interaction was performed.
Static pixels and report geometry establish readability and absence of page-wide overflow, but do not establish mobile local-scroll reachability without an observed end-scroll result.
Existing composed bilingual science/source/figure approvals were not replayed; this review does not reassess source fidelity or scientific correctness.
